quarterly_data.quarter: SJ Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (half-year report): revenue RMB 3,406,831,397.09, up 7.20% from RMB 3,177,996,180.51; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 449,359,445.31, up 3.33%; net profit after non-recurring items RMB 435,875,708.74, up 3.31%; R&D 11.57% of revenue. quarterly_data.quarter: SJ Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report, capacity build-out: the multi-layer fine-line system-integration packaging and test project (phase 1) at Jiangyin, run by subsidiary SJ Semiconductor (Jiangyin), broke ground on May 12, 2026 with total investment of about RMB 98 hundred million; the Dongsheng Hexin 3D integrated chip manufacturing project (phase 1) in Shanghai Lingang broke ground on June 29, 2026 with total investment of about RMB 100 hundred million and is planned to build 3DIC volume-production capacity. Of the IPO projects, the three-dimensional multi-chip integration packaging project (raised funds RMB 398,216.75 ten-thousand, 85.08% invested, due December 2025) has largely completed its planned capacity build, and the ultra-high-density interconnect three-dimensional multi-chip integration packaging project (RMB 79,643.35 ten-thousand) is due in December 2026. Construction in progress fell 35.51% to RMB 1,443,919,383.10 as installed equipment was put into use; payables rose 38.67% on production-equipment purchases. The company warns of the risk that the new capacity may not be absorbed.
quarterly_data.figure: Jiangyin phase 1 about RMB 98 hundred million; Lingang 3DIC phase 1 about RMB 100 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: SJ Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report, technology: in H1 2026 the company completed process development of a 6x-reticle ultra-large silicon-bridge chiplet integration solution (SmartPoser-BD; embedded silicon bridge, high-density TMV and multi-layer high-density RDL) for next-generation higher-compute chips; its micro-bump 3DIC platform SmartPoser-3DIC-BP reached volume production; the hybrid-bonding 3DIC platform SmartPoser-3DIC-HB (pitch of 10um and below) has completed full-flow verification and is being developed for C2W and W2W; SmartPoser-RDL is in small-volume trial production. Its TSV-interposer 2.5D platform SmartPoser-Si is in large-scale volume production with interposers up to about 3x reticle, integration of 10 or more functional chips and large FCBGA packages up to 75mm*75mm; the company says it is one of the earliest and largest 2.5D producers in mainland China, with no generational technology gap to the global leaders (company's claim).
quarterly_data.figure: 6x-reticle silicon-bridge integration developed; 3DIC-BP in volume production

quarterly_data.quarter: SJ Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report R&D: H1 2026 R&D spend RMB 394,162,002.15, up 7.54%, 11.57% of revenue; 875 R&D staff. Projects include SmartPoser-CPO optical-electrical co-packaging development (planned RMB 19,085.23 ten-thousand; development stage; targets passing full-flow reliability and lighting up products of different routes, for data-center networking and computing), the hybrid-bonding and TSV 3DIC platform (planned RMB 57,154.35 ten-thousand; debugging and verification), the SmartPoser-BD silicon-bridge fan-out platform (planned RMB 55,937.92 ten-thousand) and a third-generation SmartPoser-INTP thick-copper silicon interposer for CPO co-packaged optics, high-power coherent optical modules and high-performance 2.5D chips; a test platform targets 500W FT and 1200W FT/SLT testing for 2.5D and high-power chips.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 394,162,002.15 (+7.54%; 11.57% of revenue); CPO project RMB 19,085.23 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: SJ Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report, company outlook: the company will focus on the high-growth AI field, extending from training to inference and from cloud to edge and devices, while further expanding automotive and industrial business (its automotive-electronics and industrial-chip revenue grew rapidly year on year in H1 2026, no figure given); it will keep broadening products, customers and applications to drive sustainable growth.

quarterly_data.quarter: SJ Semiconductor half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report, supply: the company says core materials for chiplet multi-chip integration packaging are in tight supply and the global supply chain remains uncertain; it is validating domestic equipment and materials for chiplet grinding / dicing, WLCSP and silicon-based 2.5D. The company has been on the US Entity List since December 18, 2020, so suppliers need a US export licence to sell it controlled items. Customer concentration is high: the downstream chiplet-integration market is held by a few leading companies.
